summary: Flare Chaser is an interactive web platform that makes exploring the infrared universe accessible, engaging, and open to everyone of all ages who want to learn more about space. Inspired by the discovery of Pluto, which was identified by comparing images of the night sky to detect movement, our project brings this same discovery process to a new generation of explorers. NASA’s SPHEREx mission maps the entire sky across 102 infrared wavelength bands, with this data Flare Chaser bridges the gap of a complicated stack of data to easy accessible data by allowing users to search for celestial objects or sky coordinates and identify potential moving objects through an intuitive image blinking experience. What makes Flare Chaser unique is its Discover Mode, which takes users to random astronomical objects and allows them to explore their surroundings through an immersive 360-degree sky view. Interactive pop-ups reveal information about celestial objects, including their discovery dates and significance. By combining scientific data with interactive exploration, Flare Chaser encourages curiosity and empowers anyone to participate in exploring the universe.
details: This program is a public facing and easily accessible web based application that allows users to search coordinates or selected pre-determined targets, allowing them to view how they are moving and what makes them a target for this kind of mission. The benefits this provides is that it allows for easier access to this very complicated set of information from these missions. The intended impact is to allow any demographic let that be old or young to discover our universe. The tools we used were python for backend, JavaScript, JavaScript XML, HTML, and CSS. We used Render and Vercel for the front and backend of the website. Our project was creative because it brought a sense of interactivity to a topic that can be seen as boring, dull, and hard to access. We considered the vary large vocabulary gap that can be seen from these topics when children are trying to look at or just showing an intererst.
